tasks.label: Enable GA4 DebugView on iOS Simulator
args: set -e; ga4_device='iPhone 17'; ga4_bundle='com.example.testMap'; xcrun simctl boot "$ga4_device" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; xcrun simctl bootstatus "$ga4_device" -b; if xcrun simctl get_app_container "$ga4_device" "$ga4_bundle" app >/dev/null 2>&1; then if xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process "$ga4_device" "$ga4_bundle" -FIRDebugEnabled >/dev/null 2>&1; then sleep 1; xcrun simctl terminate "$ga4_device" "$ga4_bundle" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi; xcrun simctl spawn "$ga4_device" defaults write "$ga4_bundle" /google/firebase/debug_mode -bool YES
